hints.text: 'Heard', 'admitting', and 'essentially' are our indicators — one tells us to sound out a word, another tells us to extract a central letter, and a third tells us to place one part inside another.
Our fodder is 'escapee' and 'crime'. We'll need to use these words and their letters as directed by their neighbouring indicators.
The definition is 'Bound' — and our answer will be another way of saying this.
